records.name: Christian Medical College Ludhiana
records.description: Christian Medical College (CMC) Ludhiana is one of the oldest private medical institutions in Asia, established in 1894 as a mission hospital, offering MBBS, MD/MS, and nursing programs under Punjab Health Sciences University. The institution is known for its high ethical standards, strong clinical training, and social outreach, particularly in rural healthcare and women's health. CMC Ludhiana graduates are recognized internationally for their compassionate patient care and are well placed in hospitals across India and abroad.

records.name: Lotus Eye Hospital and Institute
records.description: Lotus Eye Hospital and Institute in Coimbatore is a leading ophthalmology specialty hospital offering clinical training and fellowship programs in various sub-specialties of eye care including cornea, retina, glaucoma, and paediatric ophthalmology. It operates a network of hospitals across Tamil Nadu and Kerala, providing students with exposure to high-volume tertiary eye care. The institute conducts outreach programs serving rural populations with preventable blindness.

records.name: Elite School of Optometry Chennai
records.description: Elite School of Optometry in Chennai, affiliated with SNDT Women's University and operated by Vision Research Foundation at Sankara Nethralaya, is one of India's premier optometry institutions offering B.Optom., M.Optom., and Ph.D. programs. Located within the Sankara Nethralaya complex, students have access to one of India's busiest and most respected eye hospitals for clinical training. The school has strong research programs in visual science, low vision rehabilitation, and contact lens practice.

records.name: LV Prasad Eye Institute
records.description: L V Prasad Eye Institute (LVPEI) in Hyderabad is one of the world's leading eye care institutions, internationally recognized for its comprehensive care, research, education, and community outreach model. It offers fellowship programs in cornea, vitreoretina, glaucoma, pediatric ophthalmology, and optometry that are among the most sought-after in Asia. LVPEI's tiered eye care model has been replicated across several countries and the institute is a WHO Collaborating Centre for prevention of blindness.

records.name: Bharati Vidyapeeth (Optometry)
records.description: Bharati Vidyapeeth Deemed University in Pune offers B.Optom. and M.Optom. programs in optometry through its College of Optometry, one of the few recognized optometry programs in Maharashtra. The college has modern optometric instrumentation labs and clinical training facilities integrated with Bharati Hospital. Bharati Vidyapeeth's optometry program is known for producing competent vision care practitioners serving hospitals, optical retail chains, and community eye care programs.

records.name: DMLT Colleges (Various)
records.description: DMLT (Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology) programs are offered by government and private medical institutions across all states, providing trained laboratory technicians for clinical, pathological, and biochemical testing. These programs are approved by respective state medical faculties or boards and typically run for two years including a practical internship. DMLT professionals are essential to the functioning of hospitals, diagnostic centers, and public health laboratories across India.

records.name: Indian Institute of Space Science and Technology (IIST)
records.description: Indian Institute of Space Science and Technology (IIST) in Thiruvananthapuram is a deemed university under the Department of Space, Government of India, and is the only space technology university in Asia dedicated exclusively to space science and technology. It offers B.Tech., M.Tech., and Ph.D. programs in aerospace engineering, avionics, and physical sciences, with a direct pipeline to ISRO for placements. IIST students work on live ISRO projects as part of their education, making it India's most specialized institution for aspiring space engineers and scientists.

records.name: Indian Institute of Petroleum Dehradun
records.description: Indian Institute of Petroleum (IIP) in Dehradun is a CSIR laboratory specializing in petroleum refining, petrochemicals, lubricant technology, and alternate fuels research. It offers Ph.D. programs through AcSIR and provides training programs for petroleum industry professionals through its Petroleum Research Institute. IIP has developed numerous refining processes and fuel formulations adopted by Indian refineries including IOCL, BPCL, and HPCL.
